features.name: utility_payment_consistency
features.label: Utility Payment Consistency
features.description: Percentage of months with on-time electricity, water, and gas payments
features.business_rationale: Consistent utility payments demonstrate regular financial commitment and discipline, even for users without a credit card or loan history.

features.name: rent_payment_consistency
features.label: Rent / EMI Payment Consistency
features.description: Percentage of months with on-time rent or EMI payments
features.business_rationale: Rent is often the largest recurring financial obligation for non-homeowners. Consistent rent payment is a strong signal of creditworthiness.

features.name: avg_payment_delay_days
features.label: Average Payment Delay
features.description: Average number of days payments are made after the due date
features.business_rationale: Even small payment delays indicate potential cash flow challenges and reduced reliability.

features.name: failed_payment_frequency
features.label: Failed Payment Frequency
features.description: Number of failed or bounced payments per year
features.business_rationale: Failed payments directly indicate insufficient funds or poor financial planning.

features.name: avg_monthly_income
features.label: Average Monthly Income
features.description: Mean monthly income in INR over the observed period
features.business_rationale: Higher income provides a larger cushion for loan repayment, reducing default risk.

features.name: income_volatility
features.label: Income Volatility
features.description: Coefficient of variation (CV) of monthly income — measures stability
features.business_rationale: High income volatility (common in gig workers) makes future repayment less predictable even if average income is adequate.

features.name: income_consistency
features.label: Income Consistency
features.description: Percentage of months with positive income (no income gap months)
features.business_rationale: Income gaps indicate periods of unemployment or income disruption that increase default risk.

features.name: income_trend
features.label: Income Trend
features.description: Direction of income change over the past 6 months (-1 declining, 0 stable, +1 growing)
features.business_rationale: Growing income signals improving financial health and lower future default risk.

features.name: transaction_success_rate
features.label: Transaction Success Rate
features.description: Percentage of attempted transactions that were completed successfully
features.business_rationale: High transaction failure rates indicate insufficient account balance, a leading indicator of financial stress.

features.name: spending_volatility
features.label: Spending Volatility
features.description: Coefficient of variation of monthly total spending
features.business_rationale: Erratic spending patterns suggest less disciplined financial management.

features.name: recurring_payment_count
features.label: Recurring Payment Count
features.description: Number of regular subscriptions or EMIs being paid consistently
features.business_rationale: Consistent recurring payments demonstrate financial discipline and reliability. Moderate count (not excessive) is positive.

features.name: essential_spending_ratio
features.label: Essential Spending Ratio
features.description: Ratio of essential (food, utilities, transport) to total monthly spending
features.business_rationale: Higher essential spending ratio indicates prudent financial prioritization.

features.name: avg_monthly_transactions
features.label: Monthly Transaction Volume
features.description: Average number of digital transactions per month
features.business_rationale: Higher transaction volume indicates active financial participation and provides more data for assessment.

features.name: mobile_recharge_regularity
features.label: Mobile Recharge Regularity
features.description: Percentage of months with consistent mobile prepaid or postpaid payment
features.business_rationale: Regular mobile payments are a proxy for consistent financial obligation fulfillment, particularly relevant for new-to-credit users.

features.name: digital_transaction_consistency
features.label: Digital Transaction Consistency
features.description: Percentage of months with regular UPI/digital payment activity
features.business_rationale: Consistent digital financial activity indicates financial participation and provides a data trail for assessment.

features.name: months_of_digital_activity
features.label: Digital Activity History
features.description: Total number of months of digital transaction history available
features.business_rationale: Longer history provides more reliable signals. Very short history (< 6 months) increases uncertainty.
